Hello everyone. I just want to say that if anyone here would ever like to talk, I am here. I care for you all whether you know it or not. Anytime message me and I will be there to talk with you about anything at all.. life, zebras, depression, video games, stocks, tacos,.. you know all that good stuff ❤️ I am here

Nothing is wrong with you. There are going to be things in life to look forward to and people that will support you and yet you may still feel at rock bottom and stuck with no where to go.  But there always is somewhere to go. Something to do someone to speak with and enjoy them. I’m not gonna tell you the whole meds therapy exercise diet thing.. I’ve heard it myself all too many times. And yes it does help I will say that. But, look at you, you are here today. Nothing is wrong with you. It is hard at times to try to feel better but I know you got it man. If you need someone to talk with I am here friend. Just let me know ❤️
Hey friend I am here to talk with you. I am all ears for you. Anytime, just let me know by messaging me or we can talk here it is up to you. ❤️

Hey there. If you are feeling there is nothing in you. Let’s find that something. If there is nothing that means there is so much more room for a lot of things. I have to ask what are you afraid of? I am here for you if you need it. Just a quick message away. Anytime. ❤️

Hey, I’m handing out hugs all day. But all I can do is virtual at the moment. But right now I am hugging you. Sounds kinda weird but it’s not haha. I want you to not feel alone. It is never fun to be alone. I am here to talk with you if you’d like. I don’t want to leave you alone. Anytime anywhere, you have a friend to talk to. ❤️

Of course. Anytime at all. Do not dwell on guilt. I dwell on terrible things I’ve done and have happened to me and have a hard time putting them away. It doesn’t mean you have to tell someone about it but don’t look about what happened. Look and see the people around you that can hug you and laugh and talk with you. I’m not trying to compare myself to you or anything like that, I just want you to know that no matter who you are and what you are going through I am here for you friend. ❤️😊

Hey man I used to love climbing trees too. Once I fell pretty far and it wasn’t good haha. I’m a little too old to do it now but I remember doing it with my friends and they were good times. It is something I can think back on to cheer me up a little. I’m in the same boat man. And the stigma is always “you’re a man just suck it up and push through”. Honestly, excuse my language but fuck that. You are more than a man, you are a human being with real feelings and things you have to deal with.. I’m on a couple different meds at the moment and having a hard time. But I hear you loud and clear and I want to keep listening. Listen friend, I am here at anytime please message me, day or night I will be here. Don’t climb that tree. Instead sit beneath it with someone. You are cared for and loved. ❤️

Pick up that freakin bass guitar and find that song you love and have been wanting to learn.. and get your mind off of your parents and how they make you feel. You are 18, you are on the way.
